item.title: Good Morning Family - 11 November 2026
item.description:
Wake up Darcy, Spencer and Neve!
Hello everyone!
Today is Wednesday, the 11 November.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 10 degrees and a top of 24 degrees.
There is about a 1 percent chance of rain.
It sounds like a good day for comfy clothes.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is C.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter C?
. . . .
